workstreams.name: Floor diagnosis, two plants
workstreams.answers: Where does conversion cost per part sit in the first two plants diagnosed, and what drives it?
activities: Observe production lines and map conversion losses
Build cost-per-part baselines from operational data
Interview the people who run the lines on loss causes

workstreams.name: Remaining plants baseline
workstreams.answers: Where does conversion cost per part sit in the third diagnosed plant and the three plants covered from data?
activities: Diagnose the third plant on the floor in a second round
Extend the baseline to the other three plants from data
Test extended baselines with the people who run each plant

workstreams.name: Improvement sizing by plant
workstreams.answers: Which improvements, sized per plant, cut conversion cost per part measurably, and which plant pilots first?
activities: Build the improvement list from loss and cost findings
Size each improvement per plant in conversion cost per part
Compare the plants as candidates to pilot first

workstreams.name: Pilot plant improvements
workstreams.answers: Do the approved improvements show savings in the cost data at the pilot plant?
activities: Prepare the pilot plant's changes for the readiness review
Make the approved changes on the lines with plant teams
Measure savings in the cost data against the baseline

workstreams.name: Cost per part tracking
workstreams.answers: What conversion cost per part does each plant show against its baseline once the improvements run?
activities: Set up the tracker on each plant's cost-per-part baseline
Report cost per part by plant as each wave goes live
Test each plant's result against the success criteria

workstreams.name: Plant rollout, wave 1
workstreams.answers: How are the improvements put in place in the first wave of plants so they run there?
activities: Adapt the pilot's changes to each plant in the wave
Make the changes in the wave's plants with their teams
Train plant teams to run the changes themselves

workstreams.name: Plant rollout, wave 2
workstreams.answers: How are the improvements put in place in the remaining plants so they run in all six?
activities: Adjust the rollout to what the first wave showed
Make the changes in the remaining plants with their teams
Train plant teams to run the changes themselves
